rule.statement: The Supreme Court has wide discretion to determine who is the proper person to be substituted in place of a deceased party in an appeal.
rule.supporting_quote: Unlike in the proceedings before the District Court, where substitution is governed by several sections of the Civil Procedure Code applicable at different stages, section 760A of the Civil Procedure Code confers the Court of Appeal wide discretion to determine, who in the opinion of the Court is the proper person to be substituted.
